scope: Actual deployed Cloudflare Worker invokes the production Modal bridge client with a deliberately unknown public test key. Endpoint401 refusal must be reached; no real job may be authorized.

minimalFailure.message: Invalid redirect value, must be one of "follow" or "manual" ("error" won't be implemented since it does not make sense at the edge; use "manual" and check the response status code).

fix: Workers supports redirect:manual, not redirect:error. Non2xx including3xx is rejected and response body cancelled before accepting a bridge result. The same Worker-only setting is fixed for Google Drive metadata and Zoom APIs.
remaining: Original full Worker/Workflow/Modal/R2 render scenario must pass after deployment; this bounded probe proves the transport fix only.
